1.text: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].<sup foot_note="227925">1</sup>

footnotes.227925: - This was a sign given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) when the Quraysh challenged him to show them a miracle.

2.text: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."<sup foot_note="227926">1</sup>

3.text: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

4.text: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

5.text: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

6.text: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller<sup foot_note="227927">1</sup> calls to something forbidding,

footnotes.227927: - Said to be an angel announcing the account and judgement.

7.text: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

8.text: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

9.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

10.text: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

11.text: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

12.text: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

13.text: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

14.text: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

15.text: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

16.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.<sup foot_note="227928">1</sup>

footnotes.227928: - To those after them, who were expected to derive a lesson from previous occurrences.

17.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

18.text: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

19.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

20.text: Extracting the people<sup foot_note="227929">1</sup> as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

21.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

22.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

24.text: And said, "Is it one human being<sup foot_note="227930">1</sup> among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

25.text: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

26.text: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

27.text: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.<sup foot_note="227931">1</sup>

footnotes.227931: - This and the following verse are an address to Ṣāliḥ (upon him be peace).

28.text: And inform them that the water is shared between them,<sup foot_note="227932">1</sup> each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

footnotes.227932: - i.e., between the tribe of Thamūd and the she-camel - a day for each to drink.

29.text: But they called their companion,<sup foot_note="227933">1</sup> and he dared<sup foot_note="227934">2</sup> and hamstrung [her].

footnotes.227933: i.e., the worst and most despicable among them.
footnotes.227934: Or "he took," referring to his sword or to the she-camel.

30.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

31.text: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

32.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

33.text: The people of Lot denied the warning.

34.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

35.text: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

36.text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

37.text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

38.text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

39.text: So taste My punishment and warning.

40.text: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

41.text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

42.text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

43.text: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

44.text: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

45.text: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].<sup foot_note="227935">1</sup>

footnotes.227935: - This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.

46.text: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

47.text: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.<sup foot_note="227936">1</sup>.

48.text: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."<sup foot_note="227937">1</sup>

footnotes.227937: - One of the proper names of Hell.

49.text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

50.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

51.text: And We have already destroyed your kinds,<sup foot_note="227938">1</sup> so is there any who will remember?

footnotes.227938: - i.e., those similar to you in attitude and behavior when they rejected Allāh's messengers.

52.text: And everything they did is in written records.

53.text: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

54.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

55.text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.<sup foot_note="227939">1</sup>

footnotes.227939: - Who accomplishes whatever He wills whenever He wills.
